name: Stratlas geographic knowledge vocabulary
scope: Metadata model only: no geospatial datasets, polygons, source responses or cached tile content are committed.

entity_types.meaning: Named geographic entity with a stable identity; not interchangeable with a map rectangle.
WGS84 bounding rectangle used to bound requests, not an authoritative administrative boundary.
Provider-identified geometry representing a tract, land parcel or zoning feature.
A measurement or classification attached to a spatial feature, with units, vintage, method and source.
A provider-maintained collection of spatial features, tabulations, or raster tile images.
A publisher-accessible API, service or discovery portal described by a catalog ID.
Presentation of source data as a basemap, fill, line, label or thematic choropleth.

place_types.meaning: Sovereign-state geographic concept; geometry requires an authority and vintage.
First-order administrative unit such as California or Jalisco.
County-level administrative unit; Los Angeles County is a study preset.
City or equivalent local administrative jurisdiction; Los Angeles City is a study preset.
Statistical enumeration geography with a vintage and provider GEOID.
Assessor parcel feature identified inside a source, not a household or person.
Planning-designation polygon, which may overlap or relate to parcels.
Future election aggregation geography; no electoral layer is currently implemented.
Rendering cell keyed by integer z/x/y, not a political or administrative place.

source_kinds.meaning: Rendered tile pictures for cartographic context, not queryable per-pixel semantic facts.
API for spatial features and source attributes (e.g. ArcGIS GeoJSON).
Aggregate statistics keyed to published geography IDs; can be joined to features.
Potential portal or provider with no wired application adapter or validated endpoint.

delivery_kinds.meaning: Cached ArcGIS MapServer tiles in z/y/x URL order.
ArcGIS feature IDs and selected GeoJSON geometries/attributes.
Structured aggregate estimates keyed to an external geography ID.
No runtime endpoint is connected; catalog entry is research only.

time_models.meaning: Service content can change independently of app releases; per-feature dates may differ.
Geometry boundaries refer to a specific named release.
Sample-based estimates cover a multi-year period, not a single point in time.
Assessment year is attached to each property record.
Provider vintage is not known at this ontology resolution.

relation_types.meaning: Project viewport preset linked to a named place, without asserting boundary equality.
Dataset's documented jurisdiction or study coverage; not a proof of complete geographic availability.
Dataset publishes features identified in that provider's namespace.
Measurement describes one geographic feature at a stated vintage.
Derived statistical value retains a trace to its source dataset/table.
Declared join between tabulations and geometry, using an explicit external identifier rule.
A map layer displays a source dataset without taking ownership of it.
Bounding-box intersection used for discovery/rendering, not containment.

identity_rules: External identifiers are scoped to their source namespace and dataset vintage.
Never substitute an internal source OBJECTID for a cross-provider stable identifier.
A study window's rectangle never asserts administrative boundary equality.
Preserve observation vintage, units, population denominator and missing/suppressed status.
An unimplemented discovery candidate is not a live data source.
